title: "Palmer Penguins Dashboard"
author: "Mikayla Julian"
format: dashboard 
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins <- penguins 
```

# Plots

## Row 1

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# removes warning pop ups
mass_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) + 
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
bill_by_island <- ggplot(penguins, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) + 
  geom_boxplot() 

ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| title: Flipper length by Mass
body_mass_flipper_length <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplotly(body_mass_flipper_length)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| title: Bill length by Mass
body_mass_bill_length <- ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point()

ggplotly(body_mass_bill_length)
```

# Data table

This dataset describes 344 indivudal penguins and comes from the 'palmerpenguins' package. These three species of penguins live on three different islands in the Palmer Archipelago.

```{r}
penguins <- penguins %>% 
  select(year)

knitr::kable(penguins)
```
